reason: Dack Fayden, Helping Hand: serialized SpellContext gains the per-object player assignment (object_player_assignment, pending_choice_member) and the choice reference set (prior_player_choices), and TargetFilter gains the ChoiceAssignment tag. An old peer drops the new context fields silently, losing a paused per-object handoff, and rejects the new tag in a stack or continuation that holds it.
